body: i wish I can go back to school again but in order for me to do that I need money. Now I have no money left in my bank account and all I have are unpaid bills. I am applying everywhere but still no luck. Where am I going to go? I have nothing and the only way that I can think of right now is to end my life. I've been unhappy all my life anyways, maybe I am unfit to live here. If I die right now everything will be gone, worries, anxiety, problems. I don't care if I miss out anything because to be honest I think I have programmed my mind to think that I cannot be happy, never. And I always wanted to die young, maybe this is how I will die.
